name: Porofessor
taglineEs: Overlay y web app especializado en champ select para League of Legends, con info instantánea de teammates y oponentes en partidas en vivo
taglineEn: Overlay and web app specialized in champ select for League of Legends, with instant teammate and opponent info in live games

screenshots.captionEs: Vista de champ select con resumen de cada jugador: rank, win rate reciente, champion mastery y nivel de tilt
screenshots.captionEn: Champ select view with each player's summary: rank, recent win rate, champion mastery, and tilt level

screenshots.captionEs: Live game con stats agregadas, threat assessment del enemigo y sugerencias de bans pre-partida
screenshots.captionEn: Live game with aggregated stats, enemy threat assessment, and pre-match ban suggestions
